description: The private stream delivers one linear BTCUSDT fill twice: the same execution frame, with the same execId, as a redelivery after a reconnect would. The OMS counts the fill once.

frames.jsonl.derivation: The transcribed execution frame, twice, byte for byte. Nothing is edited or invented: the repeat is the scenario.

expected: A repeated exec_id changes nothing: one executions row, the order's cumulative quantity as the first frame left it, no new event, no lockout and no page (E29-T05, "A duplicate push changes nothing").
